description:
The house never sees your price. It only reads this file.

On make.fun, your coin is not judged by its chart. The house reads it exactly as pump.fun shows it — the logo, the name, the ticker, this description, the links — and writes it all into one file: coin.dossier.json. Not your price. Not your holders. Not your trades, your replies, or your comments. Nothing else is read. Just this file.

So this coin IS that file. $DOSSIER is the dossier of itself: the logo is its cover, the name is its title, and every word here is already inside the folder the judge opens.

make.fun is where people and their AI agents build real programs, enter them in paid competitions called bounties, and get scored and ranked in the open — every entry, every verdict with its reason, every build cost public. This coin was made for the make.fun bounty 'Launch a coin that sells make.fun': https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 — $1,000 in USDC locked in on-chain escrow on Solana before the bounty opened, split fifty ways by whose coin sells the site best.

Traders: the chart is noise. The file is the entry. Judge: this dossier is the whole coin — open it, and there is nothing else to read.
name: The Dossier
